features.title: Study the original
features.what: Inspects the original with real tools: its pages at every width, its code, its files and how it runs.
features.evidence_quote: inspect the original: its pages at every width, its code, its files, how it runs.

features.title: 320 agent-ready tools
features.what: Each inspection tool is a command line call and an MCP tool, so an agent can drive the same engine.
features.evidence_quote: 320 tools, each one a CLI command and an MCP tool

features.title: Checked against the original
features.what: Every build is compared with the original at three screen widths, a game's self-test, or an app's runs.
features.evidence_quote: Every build is compared with the original (pages at three screen widths, a game's own self-test, an app's runs)

features.title: Coding agent builds
features.what: A coding agent builds a new project in the language, framework or engine the request names.
features.evidence_quote: a coding agent builds a new project, in the language, framework or engine your request names

features.title: No AI to inspect
features.what: Inspection needs no AI; the agent only starts once the study is done.
features.evidence_quote: No AI is needed to inspect.

features.title: Early alpha
features.what: The project is early alpha, so every build still needs checking against the original.
